title.zh: 卷155 志一百三十 邦交三 法兰西
title.raw: 卷155 志一百三十 邦交三 法兰西

sentences.zh: 法蘭西一名佛郎機，在歐羅巴之西。

translations.literal: France has another name, Folanggi; it lies in the west of Europe.
translations.idiomatic: France, also known by the older name Folanggi, lies in western Europe.

sentences.zh: 清來廣東互巿，廣東總督佟養甲疏言：「佛郎機國人寓居濠境澳門，與粵商互巿，仍禁深入省會。

translations.literal: Under the Qing, they came to Guangdong to trade reciprocally. The Guangdong governor Tong Yangjia memorialized, saying: "Nationals of Folanggi reside at Haojing Macau and trade reciprocally with Cantonese merchants, yet entry deep into the provincial capital is still forbidden."
translations.idiomatic: Under the Qing, the French began reciprocal trade at Guangdong. Governor Tong Yangjia of Guangdong reported: "Folanggi nationals live at Macau in the Haojing quarter and trade with Cantonese merchants, but they are still barred from penetrating inland to the provincial capital."

sentences.zh: 」法人素崇天主教，康熙以來，屢禁漢人入教。

translations.literal: " The French have long revered Catholicism; since the Kangxi reign, Han people have repeatedly been forbidden to enter the faith.
translations.idiomatic: " The French were devoted to Catholicism, and since the Kangxi era the court had repeatedly forbidden Han Chinese to convert.

sentences.zh: 九年五月，法公使布林布隆以進京換約為名，隨英公使普魯斯赴天津，拒不納，致傷敗數百人，折回上海，聲言調兵復仇。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the ninth year, the French minister Bourboulon, under the pretext of going to the capital to exchange treaties, followed the British minister Bruce to Tianjin; they were refused admission, and several hundred were wounded and defeated; they turned back to Shanghai and declared they would mobilize troops for revenge.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the ninth year of Xianfeng, the French minister Bourboulon, claiming he was going to Beijing to exchange treaties, accompanied the British minister Bruce to Tianjin. When China refused them entry, several hundred men were killed or wounded; they withdrew to Shanghai and threatened to bring troops for revenge.

sentences.zh: 未幾，法人復北駛，分擾登、青等處。

translations.literal: Before long, the French again sailed north and raided in separate bands at Dengzhou, Qingdao, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward French forces sailed north again and harried Dengzhou, Qingdao, and other points along the coast.

sentences.zh: 十年六月，隨英來攻，連陷新河、唐兒沽北岸砲台，遂入天津。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the tenth year, they followed the British in attacking, successively capturing the batteries on the north bank at Xinhe and Tang'ergu, and then entered Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the tenth year of Xianfeng they joined the British attack, took the north-bank batteries at Xinhe and Tanggu in succession, and advanced into Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 先是遣西寧辦事大臣文俊、武備院卿恆祺往議，不報。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Xining commissioner Wen Jun and the Wubeiyuan director Hengqi had been sent to negotiate; there was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the court had sent the Xining commissioner Wen Jun and Wubeiyuan director Hengqi to negotiate, but received no response.

sentences.zh: 至是，又遣桂良、恆福為欽差大臣，往津會議，冀緩師，而法與英益恣要求。

translations.literal: At this point, Guiliang and Hengfu were again sent as imperial commissioners to Tianjin to confer, hoping to slow the armies, but France and Britain grew ever more unrestrained in their demands.
translations.idiomatic: The court then appointed Guiliang and Hengfu imperial commissioners to confer at Tianjin in hopes of easing military pressure, but the French and British only pressed their demands more aggressively.

sentences.zh: 初，津約原許補法軍費二百萬，英四百萬。

translations.literal: At first the Tianjin treaty had originally allowed indemnities of two million for French military expenses and four million for Britain.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianjin treaty had originally set indemnities at two million taels for France and four million for Britain.

sentences.zh: 至是，英索倍加，法欲照英數，復要求天津通商、京師長駐。

translations.literal: Now Britain demanded double; France wished to follow Britain's figure and again demanded trade at Tianjin and permanent residence in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Britain now demanded double the original sum; France wanted parity with Britain and also insisted on opening Tianjin to trade and establishing permanent legations in the capital.

sentences.zh: 朝旨不許。

translations.literal: The imperial decree did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The court refused.

sentences.zh: 乃隨英督兵北上，進逼通州，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Thereupon they followed the British in leading troops north, pressing on Tongzhou; the capital was placed under martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: They then marched north with British forces, pressing toward Tongzhou, and Beijing was placed under martial law.

sentences.zh: 怡親王載垣等再議和，不就。

translations.literal: Prince Yi Zaiyuan and others negotiated peace again, but it did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yi Zaiyuan and others tried to reopen peace talks, without success.

sentences.zh: 進薄京師。

translations.literal: They advanced and pressed close to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The allied armies closed on Beijing.

sentences.zh: 八月，恭親王奕訢留守，再議和。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Prince Gong Yixin remained behind to guard the city and negotiated peace again.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Prince Gong Yixin stayed behind in the capital and reopened negotiations.

sentences.zh: 九月，和議成，所得通商、軍費、權利與英等，而傳教、建堂初無限制。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the peace agreement was concluded; the trade openings, military indemnities, and rights obtained were equal to Britain's, while proselytizing and building churches at first had no restrictions.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month peace was concluded. France gained trade concessions, indemnities, and privileges on par with Britain, and at first there were no limits on missionary activity or church construction.

sentences.zh: 十月，始定傳教之人須薙須服中國衣冠，其入內地，預領中、法合同護照，向所過地方官鈐印，以為信據。

translations.literal: In the tenth month it was first fixed that missionaries must shave the head and wear Chinese dress; those entering the interior were to obtain in advance a joint Chinese-French passport and have it sealed by local officials along the route as proof.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month regulations were set: missionaries had to shave their heads and wear Chinese dress; to enter the interior they had to carry a joint Sino-French passport stamped by each local official they passed.

sentences.zh: 法人以江南為新許商埠，欲早通商，請助剿粵賊，不許。

translations.literal: The French, because the lower Yangtze was a newly permitted trading port, wished to open trade early and requested help in suppressing the Cantonese rebels; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: With the lower Yangtze newly opened to trade, the French sought early commercial access and asked China to help suppress the Taiping rebels in Guangdong; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月，法公使布林布隆偕英使普魯斯由津如京，此為各國公使駐京之始。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eleventh year, the French minister Bourboulon together with the British minister Bruce went from Tianjin to the capital; this was the beginning of foreign ministers residing in Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eleventh year of Xianfeng, Bourboulon and Bruce traveled from Tianjin to Beijing—marking the start of permanent foreign legations in the capital.

sentences.zh: 先是條約有還清軍費始行退出廣東省城之議。

translations.literal: Earlier the treaty had provided that Guangzhou city would be evacuated only after military expenses were fully repaid.
translations.idiomatic: The treaty had stipulated that French troops would leave Guangzhou only after the indemnity was paid in full.

sentences.zh: 至是，法人哥士耆來言，原先撤兵退出粵城，並求廣東籓署賃作領事署，又索還京城及各省天主堂舊基，均許之。

translations.literal: At this point the Frenchman Gros came to say that troops would first be withdrawn from Guangzhou city, and he also requested leasing the Guangdong provincial office as a consulate and the return of former Catholic church sites in the capital and every province; all were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Gros then announced that France would withdraw from Guangzhou first, asked to lease the Guangdong provincial yamen as a consulate, and demanded the restoration of former Catholic church properties in Beijing and the provinces—all of which was granted.

sentences.zh: 九月，交還廣東省城。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Guangzhou city was handed back.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Guangzhou was returned to Chinese control.

sentences.zh: 九年夏五月，天津民擊殺法領事豐大業。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer in the ninth year, Tianjin townspeople killed the French consul Fontanier.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer in the ninth year of Tongzhi, Tianjin residents killed the French consul Henri Fontanier.

sentences.zh: 初，天津喧傳天主教堂迷拐幼孩，抉眼割心為藥料，人情洶洶。

translations.literal: At first Tianjin was abuzz with rumors that Catholic churches kidnapped children and gouged out eyes and cut out hearts for medicine, and popular feeling seethed.
translations.idiomatic: Rumors had spread through Tianjin that Catholic churches were kidnapping children and using their eyes and hearts for medicine, and public anger was running high.

sentences.zh: 三口通商大臣崇厚等詣法領事豐大業赴堂同訊，觀者麕集。

translations.literal: The trade commissioner for the three ports, Chonghou, and others went to the French consul Fontanier at the church to conduct a joint inquiry; onlookers crowded thickly.
translations.idiomatic: Trade commissioner Chonghou and others went with Fontanier to the church to investigate together, while a dense crowd of onlookers gathered.

sentences.zh: 偶與教堂人違言，磚石相拋擊，豐大業怒，徑至崇厚署忿詈，至擬以洋槍。

translations.literal: By chance they quarreled with church people; bricks and stones were thrown; Fontanier grew angry, went straight to Chonghou's office to revile him in fury, and even aimed to use a foreign gun.
translations.idiomatic: A quarrel broke out with church staff and stones began flying. Fontanier stormed into Chonghou's office, cursed him furiously, and reached for his pistol.

sentences.zh: 出遇劉傑，復以槍擊傷某僕，遂群起毆斃豐大業，鳴鑼集眾，焚毀教堂、洋房數處，教民及洋人死者數十人。

translations.literal: Going out he met Liu Jie, again shot and wounded a certain servant; thereupon the crowd rose together and beat Fontanier to death, sounded gongs to gather the multitude, burned several churches and foreign houses, and dozens of converts and foreigners died.
translations.idiomatic: Outside he encountered Liu Jie, shot and wounded a servant, and the mob then beat him to death. Gongs summoned more rioters, who burned several churches and foreign buildings; dozens of converts and foreigners were killed.

sentences.zh: 事聞，命大學士直隸總督曾國籓赴津查辦。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, Grand Secretary and Zhili governor Zeng Guofan was ordered to go to Tianjin to investigate and handle it.
translations.idiomatic: On report of the incident, Grand Secretary and Zhili governor Zeng Guofan was sent to Tianjin to investigate.

sentences.zh: 國籓至津，示諭士民，宣佈懷柔外國、息事安民之意。

translations.literal: When Guofan reached Tianjin, he issued proclamations to gentry and commoners, announcing the intent to treat foreigners with forbearance and settle affairs to reassure the people.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan reached Tianjin and issued proclamations urging restraint toward foreigners and calm among the populace.

sentences.zh: 法公使羅淑亞來見，以四事相要：曰賠修教堂；

translations.literal: The French minister Rochechouart came to an audience and pressed four demands: namely, compensation to repair churches;
translations.idiomatic: French minister Rochechouart came to negotiate and demanded four things: compensation to rebuild the churches;

sentences.zh: 曰埋葬豐大業；

translations.literal: namely, to bury Fontanier;
translations.idiomatic: a proper burial for Fontanier;

sentences.zh: 曰查辦地方官；

translations.literal: namely, to investigate and punish local officials;
translations.idiomatic: punishment of local officials;

sentences.zh: 曰懲究兇手。

translations.literal: namely, to punish and pursue the culprits.
translations.idiomatic: and prosecution of the rioters.

sentences.zh: 尋牒請將府、縣官及提督陳國瑞抵罪，國籓拒之。

translations.literal: Soon a note requested that the prefectural and county officials and the provincial commander Chen Guorui be held to account; Guofan refused.
translations.idiomatic: France soon demanded that the prefect, county magistrate, and provincial commander Chen Guorui be punished; Zeng Guofan refused.

sentences.zh: 與崇厚會奏，稱：「仁慈堂查出男女，訊無被拐情事，懇降諭各省，俾士民咸知謠傳多系虛誣，請將道、府、縣三員均撤任查辦。

translations.literal: Together with Chonghou they jointly memorialized, stating: "At the Benevolent Hall men and women were found and examined; there was no evidence of kidnapping. We beg an imperial edict to the provinces so that gentry and people may all know the rumors are mostly false, and request that the circuit, prefectural, and county officials all be removed from office for investigation."
translations.idiomatic: Zeng and Chonghou jointly reported that orphans at the Benevolent Hall showed no sign of kidnapping, asked the throne to inform every province that the rumors were largely false, and recommended removing the circuit intendant, prefect, and county magistrate pending investigation.

sentences.zh: 」奏入，報可。

translations.literal: " The memorial was submitted and approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 遂於八月擬結，辦為首十數人，天津府、縣減戍黑龍江。

translations.literal: Thereupon in the eighth month a settlement was drafted: more than a dozen ringleaders were dealt with, and the Tianjin prefect and county magistrate were commuted to penal service in Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month a settlement was reached: over a dozen ringleaders were punished, and the Tianjin prefect and county magistrate were sentenced to exile in Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 十一年，法遣全權大臣熱福里如京換約，並進書籍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, France sent plenipotentiary Gerofilo to the capital to exchange treaties and also presented books.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Tongzhi, France sent plenipotentiary Gerofilo to Beijing to exchange treaties and presented books as gifts.

sentences.zh: 十二年，穆宗親政，各國請覲見，法與焉。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, the Muzong Emperor personally took power; the various states requested audiences, and France was among them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, after the Tongzhi Emperor began personal rule, foreign powers requested audiences, France included.

sentences.zh: 是年法人侵越南，入河內省城。

translations.literal: That year the French invaded Vietnam and entered Hanoi provincial city.
translations.idiomatic: That year French forces invaded Vietnam and occupied Hanoi.

sentences.zh: 越南向隸籓屬，自法據西貢，脅越人訂約，許于紅江通舟。

translations.literal: Vietnam had long been a tributary dependency; since France seized Saigon, it coerced the Vietnamese into a treaty permitting navigation on the Red River.
translations.idiomatic: Vietnam had long been a Qing tributary. After France seized Saigon, it forced treaties on Vietnam allowing navigation on the Red River.

sentences.zh: 曾紀澤與法外部言：「法、越私立之約，中國不能認。

translations.literal: Zeng Jize said to the French foreign ministry: "Private treaties between France and Vietnam, China cannot recognize."
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Jize told the French foreign ministry: "China cannot recognize treaties concluded privately between France and Vietnam."

sentences.zh: 」不省。

translations.literal: " They did not understand.
translations.idiomatic: " France paid no heed.

sentences.zh: 八年二月，法兵船由西貢駛至海防進口。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighth year, French warships sailed from Saigon to Haiphong and entered port.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighth year of Guangxu, French warships sailed from Saigon into Haiphong.

sentences.zh: 三月，陷河內省。

translations.literal: In the third month, Hanoi province fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month they captured Hanoi.

sentences.zh: 朝議始遣提督黃桂蘭等軍出關。

translations.literal: The court at last resolved to send Provincial Commander Huang Guilan and others with armies out through the passes.
translations.idiomatic: The court finally ordered Provincial Commander Huang Guilan and other units across the border.

sentences.zh: 既而法公使寶海向北洋大臣李鴻章要求中國退兵，及通商保勝，驅逐盜賊，畫紅江南北為界。

translations.literal: Soon after, the French minister Bourée demanded of Beiyang minister Li Hongzhang that China withdraw troops, open trade at Baosheng, drive out bandits, and draw the Red River's north and south banks as a boundary.
translations.idiomatic: French minister Bourée then demanded of Li Hongzhang that China withdraw its troops, open Baosheng to trade, expel bandits, and fix the boundary along both banks of the Red River.

sentences.zh: 朝廷下各督撫議。

translations.literal: The court sent the matter down to the governors-general and governors for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The court referred the matter to provincial governors for discussion.

sentences.zh: 法人見不允所求，遂欲增軍撤使以相恫喝。

translations.literal: Seeing their demands not granted, the French then wished to increase troops and withdraw the minister to intimidate.
translations.idiomatic: When China refused, France threatened to reinforce its army and recall its minister.

sentences.zh: 九年三月，戰事起。

translations.literal: In the third month of the ninth year, hostilities began.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the ninth year of Guangxu, fighting broke out.

sentences.zh: 法據南定，旋為劉永福所敗。

translations.literal: France seized Nam Dinh and was soon defeated by Liu Yongfu.
translations.idiomatic: France took Nam Dinh but was soon defeated by Liu Yongfu's Black Flag forces.

sentences.zh: 會越王薨，法以兵脅嗣王立新約二十七條，盡攘其兵權、利權、政權，並申明越境全歸保護，中國不得干預。

translations.literal: When the Vietnamese king died, France used troops to coerce the successor king into a new twenty-seven-article treaty, seizing all military, economic, and political power and declaring the entire Vietnamese territory under protection, with China forbidden to intervene.
translations.idiomatic: When the Vietnamese king died, France forced the new king to sign a twenty-seven-article treaty stripping Vietnam of military, fiscal, and political authority, placing the whole country under French protection and barring Chinese interference.

sentences.zh: 中國聞之，乃命唐炯、徐延旭出關，彭玉麟辦粵防，張佩綸會辦軍務。

translations.literal: When China heard of it, Tang Jiong and Xu Yanxu were ordered out through the passes, Peng Yulin was put in charge of Guangdong defense, and Zhang Peilun was assigned to joint military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: China then ordered Tang Jiong and Xu Yanxu across the border, put Peng Yulin in charge of Guangdong defenses, and assigned Zhang Peilun to joint military planning.

sentences.zh: 會山西、北寧連陷，官軍退守太原，法乘勢擾浙、閩，陷基隆、澎湖，至是始宣戰。

translations.literal: When Son Tay and Bac Ninh fell in succession, government troops fell back to defend Taiyuan; France took advantage to harass Zhejiang and Fujian, seized Keelung and Penghu, and only then was war formally declared.
translations.idiomatic: After Son Tay and Bac Ninh fell, Chinese forces retreated to Taiyuan. France then raided Zhejiang and Fujian, captured Keelung and Penghu, and only then did China declare war.

sentences.zh: 十年二月，諒山大捷，法忽請和，帝命吳大澂、陳寶琛、張佩綸會辦海防，以議和全權任李鴻章。

translations.literal: In the second month of the tenth year, a great victory at Lang Son; France suddenly requested peace. The emperor ordered Wu Dacheng, Chen Baochen, and Zhang Peilun to jointly manage coastal defense, and entrusted Li Hongzhang with full powers to negotiate peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the tenth year of Guangxu, a major victory at Lang Son led France to sue for peace. The emperor put Wu Dacheng, Chen Baochen, and Zhang Peilun in charge of coastal defense and gave Li Hongzhang full authority to negotiate.

sentences.zh: 先是福祿諾所擬五條，僅允不索兵費，不入滇境，而要脅中國不再與聞越事。

translations.literal: Earlier the five articles drafted by Fournier allowed only that no military expenses would be demanded and no entry into Yunnan, but coerced China never again to concern itself with Vietnamese affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Fournier's earlier five-point draft offered only to waive indemnities and refrain from entering Yunnan, while demanding that China cease all involvement in Vietnam.

sentences.zh: 議久不決。

translations.literal: Deliberations dragged on without resolution.
translations.idiomatic: Talks dragged on without agreement.

sentences.zh: 五月，法兵以巡防為名，忽攻諒山，敗走。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, French troops under the pretext of patrol defense suddenly attacked Lang Son and were routed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month French troops, claiming they were on patrol, suddenly attacked Lang Son and were driven back in defeat.

sentences.zh: 藉口中國不能如約退師，責賠費，不允。

translations.literal: On the pretext that China could not withdraw troops as agreed, they demanded indemnity; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: France claimed China had failed to withdraw as agreed and demanded compensation; China refused.

sentences.zh: 法使巴德諾出京。

translations.literal: The French minister Patenôtre left the capital.
translations.idiomatic: French minister Patenôtre left Beijing.

sentences.zh: 六月，攻臺北基隆，為劉銘傳所敗。

translations.literal: In the sixth month they attacked Keelung in northern Taiwan and were defeated by Liu Mingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month they attacked Keelung in northern Taiwan and were repulsed by Liu Mingchuan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，法水師提督孤拔等率兵船入閩，泊馬尾等處，迫交船廠，欲據為質。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, French naval commander Courbet and others led warships into Fujian, anchored at Mawei and other places, pressed to hand over the shipyard, and wished to hold it as hostage.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Courbet led the French fleet into Fujian waters, anchored at Mawei, and demanded the Foochow Navy Yard as security.

sentences.zh: 時張佩綸以會辦海防兼船政大臣，漫不設備，法遂開砲毀船廠。

translations.literal: At the time Zhang Peilun, as joint manager of coastal defense and also shipyard superintendent, made no preparations whatsoever; France thereupon opened fire and destroyed the shipyard.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Peilun, serving as both joint coastal-defense commissioner and shipyard superintendent, had made no preparations, and the French opened fire and destroyed the yard.

sentences.zh: 復分兵擾東京、臺灣，陷基隆，窺諒山。

translations.literal: They again divided forces to harass Tonkin and Taiwan, seized Keelung, and eyed Lang Son.
translations.idiomatic: French forces then raided Tonkin and Taiwan again, reoccupied Keelung, and threatened Lang Son.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月，犯鎮南關，楊玉科戰沒。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the eleventh year, they attacked Zhennan Pass; Yang Yuke died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eleventh year of Guangxu they attacked Zhennan Pass, where Yang Yuke was killed in action.

sentences.zh: 旋收復，大創之，並砲斃孤拔於南洋。

translations.literal: Soon it was recovered and they inflicted a great defeat; Courbet was also killed by cannon fire in the southern seas.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese forces soon retook the pass and inflicted a crushing defeat; Courbet was killed by shellfire off Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 法人乃請和，原照天津原約，不索償款。

translations.literal: The French then requested peace, originally following the prior Tianjin treaty and demanding no indemnity.
translations.idiomatic: France then sued for peace on the basis of the earlier Tianjin terms, without demanding an indemnity.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章與議新約十條：一，法自行弭亂，華不派兵赴北圻；

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang negotiated a new ten-article treaty: first, France would pacify disorder on its own and China would not send troops to Tonkin;
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang negotiated a new ten-article treaty. First, France would pacify Tonkin on its own and China would not send troops there;

sentences.zh: 二，法與越自立約，或已定或續立，中、越往來，不礙中國威望體面，亦不違此次約；

translations.literal: second, treaties France concluded with Vietnam, whether already fixed or to be continued, and Sino-Vietnamese intercourse would not impair China's prestige and standing, nor violate this present treaty;
translations.idiomatic: second, treaties between France and Vietnam, existing or future, and Sino-Vietnamese relations would not impair China's prestige or violate this agreement;

sentences.zh: 三，六個月會勘界，北圻界處或稍改正，以期兩益；

translations.literal: third, within six months boundaries would be jointly surveyed, and Tonkin border places might be slightly corrected for mutual benefit;
translations.idiomatic: third, within six months commissioners would survey the border and might adjust the Tonkin line where both sides benefited;

sentences.zh: 四，法保護人民欲過界入中國，邊員給照，華人入越，請法給照；

translations.literal: fourth, French protected persons wishing to cross the border into China would receive passes from border officials; Chinese entering Vietnam would request passes from France;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, French protected persons crossing into China would carry passes issued by border officials, and Chinese entering Vietnam would obtain French passes;

sentences.zh: 五，保勝以西、諒山以北通商，華設關，法設領事，北圻亦可駐華領事；

translations.literal: fifth, trade would be opened west of Baosheng and north of Lang Son; China would establish customs posts, France consuls, and China might also station consuls in Tonkin;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, trade would open west of Baosheng and north of Lang Son; China would establish customs posts and France consulates, and China might station consuls in Tonkin as well;

sentences.zh: 六，三個月內會定商款，法運越貨稅照他處較減；

translations.literal: sixth, within three months commercial tariffs would be fixed; taxes on French goods shipped through Vietnam would be reduced compared with other places;
translations.idiomatic: sixth, tariffs would be fixed within three months, with reduced duties on French goods transshipped through Vietnam;

sentences.zh: 七，法在北圻造鐵路，中國若造鐵路，雇法工；

translations.literal: seventh, France would build railways in Tonkin; if China built railways, it would employ French workers;
translations.idiomatic: seventh, France might build railways in Tonkin, and if China built railways it would hire French engineers;

sentences.zh: 八，此約十年再修；

translations.literal: eighth, this treaty would be revised again in ten years;
translations.idiomatic: eighth, the treaty would be revised after ten years;

sentences.zh: 九，法即退基隆，二月內臺灣、澎湖全退，中、法前約照舊等語。

translations.literal: ninth, France would immediately withdraw from Keelung, and within two months fully withdraw from Taiwan and Penghu; prior Sino-French treaties would remain as before, and so forth.
translations.idiomatic: ninth, France would evacuate Keelung immediately and leave Taiwan and Penghu within two months, with earlier Sino-French agreements left in force.

sentences.zh: 旋法派戈可當代為駐華公使，欲改前約，出所擬二十四條。

translations.literal: Soon France sent Cogordan as minister resident in China, wishing to alter the prior treaty and producing twenty-four proposed articles.
translations.idiomatic: France soon appointed Cogordan minister to China; he sought to revise the treaty and submitted twenty-four new articles.

sentences.zh: 鴻章以與原約不符，不許。

translations.literal: Hongzhang held that they did not accord with the original treaty and did not permit them.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang refused, saying they conflicted with the original agreement.

sentences.zh: 戈使又欲辦滇、粵礦務，及製造土貨，運越南食鹽，復拒之。

translations.literal: Minister Cogordan again wished to manage mining in Yunnan and Guangdong, manufacture native goods, and transport Vietnamese salt; these were again refused.
translations.idiomatic: Cogordan also sought mining rights in Yunnan and Guangdong, permission to manufacture local goods, and to import Vietnamese salt—all refused.

sentences.zh: 又欲於雲南省城及廣西內地設領事。

translations.literal: He again wished to establish consulates in Yunnan provincial capital and in the interior of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to open consulates in the Yunnan capital and in inland Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 時正遣鄧承修、周德潤與法勘界，鴻章謂宜俟邊界勘明，方能指定通商碼頭。

translations.literal: At the time Deng Chengxiu and Zhou Derun were being sent to survey boundaries with France; Hongzhang said it was fitting to wait until the border was surveyed clear before designated trading ports could be fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Chengxiu and Zhou Derun were then surveying the border with France; Li Hongzhang said trading ports could be designated only after the boundary was settled.

sentences.zh: 戈使又要求稅則減半，鴻章祗允五分減一。

translations.literal: Minister Cogordan again demanded tariffs cut by half; Hongzhang allowed only a one-fifth reduction.
translations.idiomatic: Cogordan demanded a fifty-percent tariff cut; Li Hongzhang agreed only to a twenty-percent reduction.

sentences.zh: 又另擬通商章程十八款，並將互交逃犯、洋藥進出口各條亦擬在內。

translations.literal: He again separately drafted eighteen articles of commercial regulations, and also drafted within them articles on mutual surrender of fugitives and import and export of foreign opium.
translations.idiomatic: He also drafted eighteen commercial regulations, including provisions on extradition and the import and export of opium.

sentences.zh: 法使復援咸豐八年約內第七款有「工作」二字，仍要求增入在口製造，許之。

translations.literal: The French minister again cited the seventh article of the eighth year of Xianfeng treaty containing the two characters "work," and still demanded adding manufacture in the ports; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The French minister cited the word "work" in Article 7 of the 1858 treaty to demand the right to manufacture in treaty ports, and China conceded.

sentences.zh: 時雲南界務，周德潤會商岑毓英後，出關與法使狄隆晤商，擬先勘保勝上游一二段，並同擬全局辦法八條：一，中、法兩國勘界大臣等說明所應勘之界，俱是現在之界；

translations.literal: At the time, for Yunnan border affairs, after Zhou Derun conferred with Cen Yuying, he went out through the passes to meet French minister Dilhonne; they planned first to survey one or two sections upstream of Baosheng, and jointly drafted eight general methods: first, the Chinese and French boundary commissioners would explain that the borders to be surveyed were all present borders;
translations.idiomatic: For the Yunnan border, Zhou Derun consulted Cen Yuying, crossed the frontier to meet French commissioner Dilhonne, agreed to survey first one or two sections upstream of Baosheng, and drafted eight general principles: first, both sides would survey only the existing boundary;

sentences.zh: 一，勘現界後，或有改正之處，兩國勘界大臣公同商酌，如彼此意見不合，各請旨商辦；

translations.literal: second, after surveying the present border, if there were places needing correction, the two countries' boundary commissioners would consult together; if opinions did not agree, each would request instructions for deliberation;
translations.idiomatic: second, after surveying, any corrections would be negotiated jointly, with disputes referred to both governments;

sentences.zh: 一，續開勘雲、越交界，中國大臣等意欲一律勘完，所以照會法國請旨；

translations.literal: third, continuing to open survey of the Yunnan-Vietnam border junction, the Chinese commissioners wished to survey it all uniformly to completion, and therefore notified France to request instructions;
translations.idiomatic: third, China wished to complete the entire Yunnan-Vietnam border survey and so notified France to seek instructions;

sentences.zh: 一，各大臣等商議先由老街勘到龍膊河，及龍膊河鄰近地方，復回老街，再勘老街鄰近地方；

translations.literal: fourth, the commissioners deliberated to survey first from Laokai to the Longbo River and nearby places of the Longbo River, then return to Laokai and again survey places near Laokai;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, they agreed to survey from Laokai to the Longbo River and its vicinity, return to Laokai, then survey the Laokai area;

sentences.zh: 一，勘老街至龍膊河之界，中、法繪圖各官從紅江南岸歸，一路同走，中國繪圖官歸法國保護，自老街起至龍膊河止，兩國勘界大臣等各走雲、越邊界；

translations.literal: fifth, surveying the border from Laokai to the Longbo River, Chinese and French mapping officers would return along the south bank of the Red River, walking the same route together; Chinese mapping officers would be under French protection; from Laokai to the Longbo River, boundary commissioners of both countries would each walk the Yunnan and Vietnam border respectively;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, for the Laokai–Longbo sector, Chinese and French surveyors would travel together along the south bank of the Red River under French escort, while commissioners walked the Chinese and Vietnamese sides respectively;

sentences.zh: 一，紅河自北河岸之老鏊至南岸之龍膊，以河中為界；

translations.literal: sixth, from Lao'ao on the north bank of the Red River to Longbo on the south bank, the middle of the river would serve as the boundary;
translations.idiomatic: sixth, from Lao'ao on the north bank to Longbo on the south, the river's mid-channel would be the boundary;

sentences.zh: 一，雲、越之界，遇有以河為界，均以河中為界，如有全河現在歸中國界者，仍歸中國，現在歸越南界者，仍歸越南；

translations.literal: seventh, where the Yunnan-Vietnam border used a river as boundary, the middle of the river would uniformly serve; if an entire river presently belonged to China's border, it would still belong to China; if presently to Vietnam's border, still to Vietnam;
translations.idiomatic: seventh, wherever a river formed the border, the mid-channel would divide it; rivers wholly on the Chinese side would remain Chinese, and those wholly on the Vietnamese side would remain Vietnamese;

sentences.zh: 一，勘界時隨處開節略圖說，均由兩國大臣等畫押。

translations.literal: eighth, during boundary survey, brief maps and explanations opened everywhere would all be signed and sealed by commissioners of both countries.
translations.idiomatic: eighth, provisional maps and notes made during the survey would be signed by commissioners of both sides.

sentences.zh: 以上節略，彼此畫押遵守。

translations.literal: The above brief points, each side signed and sealed to observe.
translations.idiomatic: Both parties signed these provisions and pledged to abide by them.

sentences.zh: 德潤與狄隆各按地圖校改，互有爭執，而於大小賭呪河、猛援、猛賴兩段，爭執尤力。

translations.literal: Derun and Dilhonne each corrected according to maps; they disputed one another, and over the sections of the Greater and Lesser Duzhou Rivers and Mengyuan and Menglai they disputed especially fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Derun and Dilhonne revised maps against each other and clashed repeatedly, especially over the Greater and Lesser Duzhou Rivers and the Mengyuan and Menglai sectors.

sentences.zh: 會法勘路弁兵在者蘭被越遊勇所戕，法指為雲南提督散勇，中國不承，狄隆欲緩勘，但就圖定界。

translations.literal: When French route-surveying soldiers at Zhelan were killed by Vietnamese irregulars, France pointed to them as Yunnan provincial commander's dispersed braves; China did not acknowledge it; Dilhonne wished to slow the survey and fix the boundary only from maps.
translations.idiomatic: When French survey troops were killed by Vietnamese irregulars at Zhelan, France blamed Yunnan's provincial commander; China denied it, and Dilhonne proposed suspending the survey and fixing the line from maps alone.

sentences.zh: 粵東、粵西界務，鄧承修與張之洞、李秉衡等會商，其與法使浦理燮在關門文淵會議。

translations.literal: For Guangdong east and west border affairs, Deng Chengxiu conferred with Zhang Zhidong, Li Bingheng, and others; he met French minister Pouliche at Guanmen and Wenyuan for conference.
translations.idiomatic: For the Guangdong border, Deng Chengxiu consulted Zhang Zhidong and Li Bingheng, then met French commissioner Pouliche at Guanmen and Wenyuan.

sentences.zh: 承修執約內「北圻邊界必要更正，以期兩國有益」之語，欲以諒山迤西自艽葑、高平省至保樂州，東自祿平、那陽、先妥州至海寧府劃歸中界。

translations.literal: Chengxiu held to the treaty phrase "Tonkin border must be corrected for mutual benefit of both countries," wishing from west of Lang Son from Mangcang and Gaoping province to Baole prefecture, and east from Luping, Nayang, and Xiantuo prefectures to Haining prefecture, to draw all within the Chinese border.
translations.idiomatic: Chengxiu cited the treaty's clause on correcting the Tonkin border for mutual benefit and sought to bring within China's line the territory from Mangcang and Gaoping west of Lang Son to Baole, and from Luping, Nayang, and Xiantuo east to Haining.

sentences.zh: 浦使以據約不過於兩邊界址略為更改，不能及諒山及東西地。

translations.literal: Minister Pou said that according to the treaty it could not go beyond slightly altering the boundary sites on both sides, and could not reach Lang Son and the eastern and western territories.
translations.idiomatic: Pouliche replied that the treaty allowed only minor adjustments along the existing line, not changes reaching Lang Son or the eastern and western regions.

sentences.zh: 旋允請示本國，卒不行。

translations.literal: Soon he agreed to request instructions from his country, but in the end it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: He agreed to refer the matter to Paris, but the proposal was ultimately rejected.

sentences.zh: 十二年復議界，會浦理燮病，僅由鎮南起勘至平關而止，東西不過三百餘里，餘未履勘。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the border was discussed again; as Pouliche fell ill, survey ran only from Zhennan starting to Pingguan and stopped; east to west was no more than three hundred-odd li; the rest was not trodden in survey.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year boundary talks resumed, but Pouliche fell ill; survey ran only from Zhennan Pass to Pingguan—about three hundred li east to west—with the rest unsurveyed.

sentences.zh: 浦理燮旋回國，法改派狄隆由滇赴粵，與鄧承修等議界。

translations.literal: Pouliche soon returned home; France reassigned Dilhonne from Yunnan to go to Guangdong to deliberate the boundary with Deng Chengxiu and others.
translations.idiomatic: Pouliche soon returned to France; France reassigned Dilhonne from Yunnan to Guangdong to negotiate the border with Deng Chengxiu and others.

sentences.zh: 先是鴻章欲先議界，後議商約，法使不從，乃復議商約。

translations.literal: Earlier Hongzhang had wished to deliberate the boundary first and the commercial treaty afterward; the French minister did not agree, and they returned to deliberating the commercial treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang had wanted to settle the boundary before the commercial treaty, but the French minister refused, so talks returned to the commercial treaty.

sentences.zh: 至是議成十九款：一，保勝以上某處、諒山以北某處，中國設關通商，許法設立領事；

translations.literal: At this point nineteen articles were agreed: first, at certain places above Baosheng and certain places north of Lang Son, China would establish customs for trade and permit France to establish consuls;
translations.idiomatic: Nineteen articles were then agreed: first, at designated points above Baosheng and north of Lang Son, China would open customs stations for trade and allow France to appoint consuls;

sentences.zh: 二，中國可在河內、海防二處設立領事，並可商酌在北圻他處設領事，惟須後日；

translations.literal: second, China might establish consuls at Hanoi and Haiphong, and might consult on establishing consuls elsewhere in Tonkin, but only at a later date;
translations.idiomatic: second, China might open consulates at Hanoi and Haiphong and consult on consulates elsewhere in Tonkin, but only at a later date;

sentences.zh: 三，兩國領事駐紮及商民通商，均須優待；

translations.literal: third, consular residence of both countries and merchants' trade must all receive preferential treatment;
translations.idiomatic: third, consuls of both states and their merchants were to receive preferential treatment in residence and trade;

sentences.zh: 四，中國人在越置地建屋，及官商往來公文、書信、電報，法允保護遞送；

translations.literal: fourth, Chinese in Vietnam acquiring land and building houses, and official and merchant correspondence, letters, and telegrams—France permitted protection and delivery;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, Chinese in Vietnam might acquire land and build houses; France would protect and forward official and commercial documents, letters, and telegrams;

sentences.zh: 五，兩國遊歷人過界，各發給護照；

translations.literal: fifth, travelers of both countries crossing the border would each be issued passports;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, travelers crossing the frontier would each be issued passports by their own government;

sentences.zh: 六、七，出口貨照稅則三分減一，進口貨照稅則五分減一，估價之貨為稅則所未載者，進出口仍照值百抽五徵收，至洋土各貨赴內地買賣，應完子口稅，不在減徵之列；

translations.literal: sixth and seventh, export goods per tariff reduced by one-third, import goods per tariff reduced by one-fifth; goods valued but not listed in the tariff still taxed five percent on value for import and export; as for foreign and native goods going to the interior for trade, they should pay transit dues and were not within reductions;
translations.idiomatic: sixth and seventh, export duties were cut by one-third and import duties by one-fifth under the tariff; unlisted goods were still taxed at five percent ad valorem; foreign and native goods sold inland remained subject to transit dues and were excluded from the reductions;

sentences.zh: 八、九，載明洋、土各貨在邊關已完稅，復轉運通商各海關者，均照海關稅則另收正稅，不以邊關單作抵，其在邊關所領存票，亦只准在邊關抵稅，概不發還現銀；

translations.literal: eighth and ninth, stipulated that foreign and native goods having paid tax at border customs and re-exported to treaty-port customs all paid regular duty per customs tariff without offsetting by border customs receipts; deposit tickets issued at border customs might only offset tax at border customs and would not be refunded in cash;
translations.idiomatic: eighth and ninth, goods taxed at border stations and re-shipped to treaty ports paid full customs duties there without credit for border payments; deposit tickets issued at the border could offset duties only at the border and were never redeemed in silver;

sentences.zh: 十至十二，嚴防詐偽偷漏之法；

translations.literal: tenth through twelfth, methods strictly guarding against fraud and smuggling;
translations.idiomatic: articles ten through twelve set strict rules against fraud and smuggling;

sentences.zh: 十三，定洋人自用雜物免稅之法；

translations.literal: thirteenth, fixed the method for foreigners' personal effects exempt from tax;
translations.idiomatic: thirteenth, fixed rules exempting foreigners' personal effects from duty;

sentences.zh: 十四，定洋、土各藥不准販運買賣；

translations.literal: fourteenth, fixed that foreign and native drugs were not permitted to be transported or sold;
translations.idiomatic: fourteenth, prohibited the transport and sale of foreign and native drugs;

sentences.zh: 十五，米穀等糧不准販運出中國邊關，進關准免稅，違禁物各禁；

translations.literal: fifteenth, grain such as rice and millet was not permitted to be transported out of China's border passes; entry was permitted duty-free; various prohibited goods were each prohibited;
translations.idiomatic: fifteenth, grain might not be exported through China's border passes but entered duty-free; other contraband was likewise banned;

sentences.zh: 十六，中國商民僑居越南，所有命案、賦稅、詞訟等件，法國應優待；

translations.literal: sixteenth, for Chinese merchants resident in Vietnam, all cases of life and death, taxes, and lawsuits—France should treat preferentially;
translations.idiomatic: sixteenth, France would treat Chinese merchants residing in Vietnam preferentially in criminal cases, taxation, and litigation;

sentences.zh: 十七，中國人犯罪，照中律，法領事宜拘送，不得庇匿；

translations.literal: seventeenth, Chinese committing crimes were punished per Chinese law; French consular officials should detain and hand over, not shelter and conceal;
translations.idiomatic: seventeenth, Chinese offenders were to be punished under Chinese law; French consuls must detain and surrender them and not harbor fugitives;

sentences.zh: 十八、十九，定條約續修期限及互換遵守各事。

translations.literal: eighteenth and nineteenth, fixed the treaty revision period and matters of exchange and mutual observance.
translations.idiomatic: eighteenth and nineteenth, fixed the period for treaty revision and procedures for exchange and mutual compliance.

sentences.zh: 是為滇粵邊界通商約。

translations.literal: This was the Yunnan-Guangdong border commercial treaty.
translations.idiomatic: This became the Yunnan–Guangdong border trade treaty.

sentences.zh: 商約既定，鄧承修即赴欽州之東興與狄隆議勘東界。

translations.literal: Once the commercial treaty was settled, Deng Chengxiu at once went to Dongxing in Qinzhou to deliberate surveying the eastern border with Dilhonne.
translations.idiomatic: Once the commercial treaty was signed, Deng Chengxiu went to Dongxing in Qinzhou to survey the eastern border with Dilhonne.

sentences.zh: 狄隆以中國所屬江平、黃竹、白龍尾為越境。

translations.literal: Dilhonne held that Jiangping, Huangzhu, and Bailongwei, belonging to China, were Vietnamese territory.
translations.idiomatic: Dilhonne claimed Jiangping, Huangzhu, and Bailongwei—Chinese territory—as Vietnamese land.

sentences.zh: 鄧承修以數地皆內地，有圖可據，不許。

translations.literal: Deng Chengxiu held that all several places were interior territory, with maps for evidence, and did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Chengxiu refused, citing maps showing all were interior Chinese territory.

sentences.zh: 辯論不洽。

translations.literal: Debate did not reach agreement.
translations.idiomatic: Talks broke down.

sentences.zh: 狄隆又約履勘，承修欲照雲南分途履勘辦法，並請先撤江平法兵。

translations.literal: Dilhonne again proposed trodden survey; Chengxiu wished to follow the Yunnan method of separate-route survey and also asked first to withdraw French troops from Jiangping.
translations.idiomatic: Dilhonne proposed an on-site survey; Chengxiu wanted the Yunnan practice of separate routes and demanded French troops withdraw from Jiangping first.

sentences.zh: 越日，復議請旨立約三條：一，大段相合；

translations.literal: The next day, again deliberating, they requested imperial instruction to establish a treaty of three articles: first, large sections accord;
translations.idiomatic: The next day they again sought imperial approval for a three-article pact: first, where the line largely agreed;

sentences.zh: 二，較圖不合，作為未定，各請示本國；

translations.literal: second, where maps disagreed, treat as undetermined, each request instructions from own country;
translations.idiomatic: second, disputed stretches would remain undecided pending instructions from both governments;

sentences.zh: 三，勒其去江平之兵及辦事官員。

translations.literal: third, compel removal of troops and administrative personnel from Jiangping.
translations.idiomatic: third, French troops and officials must leave Jiangping.

sentences.zh: 又令以後未定界內，不得再派兵及官員前往。

translations.literal: Also ordered that within undetermined border hereafter, troops and officials must not again be dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: They also barred further troop or official deployments in undemarcated areas.

sentences.zh: 狄隆不允，轉要承修不得於未定界內駐兵。

translations.literal: Dilhonne did not agree, in turn demanding Chengxiu not station troops within undetermined border.
translations.idiomatic: Dilhonne refused and instead demanded that Chengxiu not garrison troops in disputed territory.

sentences.zh: 時張之洞所派道員王之春、李興銳亦與會議。

translations.literal: At the time circuit intendants Wang Zhichun and Li Xingrui dispatched by Zhang Zhidong also participated in conference.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit intendants Wang Zhichun and Li Xingrui, sent by Zhang Zhidong, also joined the talks.

sentences.zh: 議界將及一年，中國屢請撤兵，法兵分屯江平、黃竹、石角、句冬、白龍尾等處如故。

translations.literal: Border deliberation neared a year; China repeatedly requested troop withdrawal; French troops still garrisoned Jiangping, Huangzhu, Shijiao, Goudong, Bailongwei and other places as before.
translations.idiomatic: After nearly a year of talks China repeatedly asked France to withdraw, but French troops still held Jiangping, Huangzhu, Shijiao, Goudong, Bailongwei, and other posts.

sentences.zh: 會總署允承修所定三條，承修命王之春往議，狄隆執不允，而法人突以兵踞白龍尾，驅害汛兵。

translations.literal: When the Zongli Yamen approved Chengxiu's three articles, Chengxiu ordered Wang Zhichun to go negotiate; Dilhonne obstinately did not agree; meanwhile French suddenly occupied Bailongwei with troops and drove and harmed garrison soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zongli Yamen approved Chengxiu's three articles, he sent Wang Zhichun to negotiate; Dilhonne still refused, and French troops suddenly seized Bailongwei and attacked Chinese garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 華民築營壘，承修詰令撤退，狄隆諉之。

translations.literal: Chinese people built fortifications; Chengxiu interrogated and ordered withdrawal; Dilhonne evaded responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese civilians built fortifications; Chengxiu demanded their removal, but Dilhonne disclaimed responsibility.

sentences.zh: 時桂界已校竣，欽界南自嘉隆河、北抵北侖十萬山分茅嶺、西至峒中墟北，亦允歸中國，而白龍、江平，狄隆謂須以商務抵換。

translations.literal: At the time the Guangxi border had been surveyed and completed; for the Qinzhou border from Jialong River in the south north to Fenmaoling of Beilun Shiwanshan, west to north of Dongzhong market—all permitted to return to China; but for Bailong and Jiangping, Dilhonne said commercial affairs must be exchanged as offset.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangxi line was already settled; from the Jialong River south to Fenmaoling on Beilun's Shiwanshan ridge and west to north of Dongzhong market was conceded to China, but Dilhonne insisted Bailongwei and Jiangping must be traded for commercial concessions.

sentences.zh: 又以九頭山未議，及之春與議，亦無效。

translations.literal: Also because Jiutoushan was not yet discussed, even Wang Zhichun joining deliberation was ineffective.
translations.idiomatic: Jiutoushan remained unsettled; even Wang Zhichun's participation changed nothing.

sentences.zh: 狄隆又欲議海界，以津約所無，未奉旨議海界，卻之。

translations.literal: Dilhonne again wished to deliberate maritime border; as the Tianjin treaty had nothing on it and no imperial instruction to deliberate maritime border, this was refused.
translations.idiomatic: Dilhonne also sought to negotiate the maritime boundary; China refused, citing the Tianjin treaty and the lack of imperial authorization.

sentences.zh: 法又欲以白龍、江平抵換龍州通商。

translations.literal: France again wished to exchange Bailong and Jiangping for Longzhou commercial access.
translations.idiomatic: France also offered to trade Bailongwei and Jiangping for opening Longzhou to commerce.

sentences.zh: 初恭思當來華也，即有求改商約之請，總署以界務方殷，且商約既經畫押，何能議改？

translations.literal: When Gongsin first came to China, there was already a request to alter the commercial treaty; the Yamen held border affairs were still pressing, and the commercial treaty had already been initialed—how could it be discussed for alteration?
translations.idiomatic: When Gongsin first arrived in China he had already asked to revise the commercial treaty; the Yamen refused, citing urgent border affairs and the treaty already having been initialed.

sentences.zh: 拒之。

translations.literal: Refused.
translations.idiomatic: The request was refused.

sentences.zh: 至是復以為請，並以商務苟可通融，界務亦可稍讓。

translations.literal: At this point again made the request, and said if commercial affairs might be accommodated flexibly, border affairs might also be slightly yielded.
translations.idiomatic: He renewed the request, saying that if commercial terms could be adjusted, border concessions might follow.

sentences.zh: 稱已奉本國訓，准令在京商辦。

translations.literal: Said already received instructions from home country, permitting deliberation in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He said he had received instructions from Paris authorizing negotiations in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 總署以狄隆與鄧承修議界久不決，允與商辦。

translations.literal: The Yamen, because Dilhonne and Deng Chengxiu deliberated border long without decision, permitted commercial deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Because Dilhonne and Deng Chengxiu had deadlocked on the border, the Yamen agreed to commercial talks.

sentences.zh: 恭思當始允中國廣東邊界除現在勘界大臣劃定外，所有白龍尾及江平、黃竹一帶地方，並雲南邊界前歸另議之南丹山以北、西至狗頭寨、東至清水河一帶地方，均歸中國管轄。

translations.literal: Gongsin at first agreed that China's Guangdong border, apart from what present boundary commissioners surveyed and fixed, all Bailongwei and Jiangping, Huangzhu belt, and Yunnan border formerly returned to separate discussion—north of Nandanshan, west to Goutouzhai, east to Qingshuihe belt—all returned to Chinese jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Gongsin initially conceded that beyond what the commissioners were then surveying, Bailongwei, Jiangping, Huangzhu, and the Yunnan tract north of Nandanshan between Goutouzhai and the Qingshui River would remain under Chinese jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 又議減稅，總署以俄國通商章程辦有成案，滇、桂邊界皆為陸路，不得不酌議減稅，以歸平允。

translations.literal: Also deliberated tax reduction; the Yamen held Russia's commercial regulations had established precedents; Yunnan and Guangxi borders were all overland routes—must deliberate tax reduction to restore fairness.
translations.idiomatic: On tariff reductions the Yamen cited Russian precedents and held that overland routes on the Yunnan and Guangxi frontiers required moderated duties for equity.

sentences.zh: 於是議進口稅減十分之三，出口稅減十分之四，滇土藥每百斤定稅釐各二十兩，必完釐者，方准法商完稅接買，並不准法、越商人往入內地販運，高平、諒山往來之船隻免徵稅，仍納船錢，惟運販食鹽、接辦鐵路及越南與滇、粵通商進出口稅則，均請減半，運中國土貨往中國各海口，稅則減三分之一各節，均拒絕刪節。

translations.literal: Thereupon import tax reduced three-tenths, export tax four-tenths; Yunnan native drugs per hundred jin fixed lijin twenty taels each—only after completing lijin might French merchants complete tax and purchase; also not permitted French and Vietnamese merchants to enter interior for transport and sale; Gaoping and Lang Son traveling vessels exempt from tax but still paid vessel fees; only transport and sale of salt, undertaking railways, and Vietnam with Yunnan-Guangdong trade import-export tariff—all requested halving, transport Chinese native goods to Chinese ports tariff reduced one-third—all these articles were refused deletion.
translations.idiomatic: Import duties were cut by thirty percent and export duties by forty; Yunnan native drugs were taxed at twenty taels of lijin per hundred jin before French merchants might buy them; French and Vietnamese traders were barred from the interior; vessels between Gaoping and Lang Son paid no duty but still paid tonnage fees. China rejected French demands to halve duties on salt, railways, and Vietnam–Yunnan–Guangdong trade, and to cut tariffs on native goods shipped to treaty ports by one-third.

sentences.zh: 計訂商務續約十條，界務續約四條。

translations.literal: In all ten commercial supplementary articles and four boundary supplementary articles were concluded.
translations.idiomatic: In all, ten commercial supplementary articles and four boundary supplementary articles were concluded.

sentences.zh: 又照會緩設領事，及法在龍、蒙等處之領事等官，不得設立租界二端。

translations.literal: Also notes deferring establishment of consuls, and French consular officials at Longzhou, Mengzi and other places not permitted to establish concessions—two matters.
translations.idiomatic: Notes also deferred consular establishments and barred French consuls at Longzhou, Mengzi, and elsewhere from creating concessions.

sentences.zh: 是為與法勘界通商續約。

translations.literal: This was the supplementary treaty on boundary survey and trade with France.
translations.idiomatic: This was the supplementary Sino-French treaty on boundary survey and trade.

sentences.zh: 十四年，法領事藉口華船常到海防，向廉州請示諭船戶須向領事領照，無照即將船扣留。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, French consul citing Chinese ships often coming to Haiphong, requested instruction from Lianzhou telling ship owners they must obtain licenses from consul, without license ships would be detained.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Guangxu (1888), the French consul, citing frequent Chinese visits to Haiphong, asked Lianzhou to order shipowners to obtain consular licenses on pain of detention.

sentences.zh: 張之洞以條約向章所無，海防各國船隻均可往，何獨華船不許？

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong held treaty had nothing on this; all countries' ships at Haiphong might go—why alone Chinese ships not permitted?
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong replied that the treaty said nothing of the kind and that ships of all nations used Haiphong—why bar Chinese vessels alone?

sentences.zh: 嗣聞法領事張貼告白，收取船規，每船輸銀自數元至數十元不等，雲系法使所定。

translations.literal: Later heard French consul posted proclamation collecting ship fees; each ship paid silver from several yuan to several tens yuan unequal; said this was fixed by French minister.
translations.idiomatic: He later learned the consul had posted notices charging ship fees of several to several tens taels each, claiming authority from the French minister.

sentences.zh: 之洞致總署請其停止收規。

translations.literal: Zhidong wrote Yamen requesting it stop collecting fees.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong asked the Yamen to halt the levies.

sentences.zh: 是年，法人請接中國兩粵電線，許之。

translations.literal: That year, French requested connecting Guangdong telegraph lines—permitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year France asked to link its telegraph lines with Guangdong's, and permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 又芒街法兵越界焚劫那沙，之洞致總署，請向法使責賠償。

translations.literal: Also Mangjie French troops crossed border burning and plundering Nasha; Zhidong wrote Yamen requesting French minister be charged for compensation.
translations.idiomatic: French troops from Mang Cai also crossed the border to burn and plunder Nasha; Zhang Zhidong urged the Yamen to demand compensation from the French minister.

sentences.zh: 十五年，法船駛進瓊州所屬崖州東百里之榆林港測探水道，上岸釘椿插標，阻之。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, French ships entered Yulin Harbor east of Yazhou in Qiongzhou prefecture's jurisdiction a hundred li to survey channels, going ashore driving stakes and planting markers—obstructed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Guangxu (1889), French vessels entered Yulin Harbor, a hundred li east of Yazhou in Qiongzhou, to survey the channel and plant markers on shore; they were stopped.

sentences.zh: 法領事又在北海徵收漁船照費，政府以有侵中國主權，不許。

translations.literal: French consul again at Beihai collected fishing boat license fees; government held this infringed Chinese sovereignty—not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The French consul also levied license fees on fishing boats at Beihai; the government refused, holding this an infringement of sovereignty.

sentences.zh: 十月，定界委員李受彤與法官勘東興一帶河界，定議此後河中淤有沙洲，近華者歸華，近越者歸越，河道即有更改，無論河在何境，兩國均許行船。

translations.literal: Tenth month, boundary commissioners Li Shoutong and French judge surveyed river border around Dongxing; agreed that hereafter if sandbars silted in river, those near China returned to China, those near Vietnam to Vietnam; even if river course changed, regardless of which territory the river was in, both countries permitted navigation.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month boundary commissioner Li Shoutong and a French judge surveyed the river line near Dongxing, agreeing that future sandbars would belong to whichever side they lay nearer, that shifting channels would not alter navigation rights, and that both states might sail the river regardless of jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 是年，法使以華兵駐越南之板邦為言。

translations.literal: That year, French minister raised Chinese troops stationed at Banbang in Vietnam.
translations.idiomatic: That year the French minister protested Chinese troops stationed at Banbang in Vietnam.

sentences.zh: 又稱那沙墟不在中國界內，實在北圻橫模社對面先安河北岸，與板邦相近。

translations.literal: Also said Nasha market was not within Chinese border, actually on north bank of Xian'an River opposite Hengmo commune in Tonkin, near Banbang.
translations.idiomatic: He also claimed Nasha market lay outside China, on the north bank of the Xian'an River opposite Hengmo commune in Tonkin, near Banbang.

sentences.zh: 又稱去冬官兵迎收被剿敗匪，系指離芒街八里之寧陽大廟對面大河北岸而言。

translations.literal: Also said last winter officials and troops receiving surrendered routed bandits referred to north bank of great river opposite Ningyang Temple eight li from Mangjie.
translations.idiomatic: He further said that last winter's reception of routed bandits by Chinese troops referred to the north bank opposite Ningyang Temple, eight li from Mang Cai.

sentences.zh: 並命查復。

translations.literal: Also ordered investigation and reply.
translations.idiomatic: An investigation was ordered.

sentences.zh: 嗣李受彤復電，謂：「州西分界，自八莊曆板興、板山、冷峒止，前有溝離越南峒中三里，即以此溝為界，冷峒系醜艮寅向，峒中系未坤申向，那沙在西北，戌乾亥向，峒中墟居中，兩旁有溝，水向西合流入先安省。

translations.literal: Later Li Shoutong telegraphed reply saying: "West of prefecture boundary delimitation, from Bazhuang through Banxing, Banshan, Lengdong stopping; before was ditch three li from Vietnamese Dongzhong—take this ditch as border; Lengdong is chou-gen-yin direction, Dongzhong is wei-kun-shen, Nasha in northwest xu-qian-hai direction; Dongzhong market centered, ditches on both sides, water westward joining flowing into Xian'an province.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shoutong later telegraphed: "The western prefectural boundary runs from Bazhuang through Banxing, Banshan, and Lengdong. A ditch three li from Vietnamese Dongzhong serves as the line. By compass bearing, Lengdong lies chou-gen-yin, Dongzhong wei-kun-shen, and Nasha northwest at xu-qian-hai. Dongzhong market stands between two ditches whose waters flow west into Xian'an province."

sentences.zh: 以方向論，溝西南概為越地，溝西北概為華地。

translations.literal: By direction, southwest of ditch broadly Vietnamese land, northwest broadly Chinese land.
translations.idiomatic: By orientation, land southwest of the ditch is broadly Vietnamese and northwest broadly Chinese.

sentences.zh: 以社論，那沙與板峒為建延社地，與峒中為橫模社地無涉。

translations.literal: By commune, Nasha and Bandong are Jiayan commune land, unrelated to Dongzhong as Hengmo commune.
translations.idiomatic: By village jurisdiction, Nasha and Bandong belong to Jiayan commune, not to Hengmo commune centered at Dongzhong.

sentences.zh: 以交界論，那沙北曆那懷，約二十五里即北岩，系廣西上思州地。

translations.literal: By border junction, Nasha north through Nahuaai about twenty-five li then Beiyan, is Guangxi Shangsi prefecture land.
translations.idiomatic: By proximity to the border, north of Nasha through Nahuaai lies Beiyan, about twenty-five li away, in Guangxi's Shangsi prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以欽差所定界圖論，那懷屬我，那沙即附連那懷，相離僅三里，前並無墟。

translations.literal: By commissioner delimited border map, Nahuaai belongs to us, Nasha adjoins Nahuaai, separated only three li, formerly no market.
translations.idiomatic: On the imperial commissioner's map Nahuaai is Chinese territory; Nasha adjoins it only three li away and had no market before.

sentences.zh: 去年正月，峒中墟華民始由峒中遷此。

translations.literal: Last year first month, Dongzhong market Chinese people first migrated here from Dongzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Last year in the first month Chinese from Dongzhong market first moved here.

sentences.zh: 去年十一月以前，法未逾溝到此，十二月始有焚殺那沙墟事，擄去婦女，隨即給銀放回。

translations.literal: Before last year eleventh month, France had not crossed ditch coming here; twelfth month began burning and killing Nasha market affair, carrying off women, immediately gave silver to release.
translations.idiomatic: Before the eleventh month last year the French had not crossed the ditch; in the twelfth month they burned Nasha market, abducted women, then paid silver for their release.

sentences.zh: 其法官自向婦女言系逾界誤拏。

translations.literal: Their judge himself told women it was crossing border mistaken capture.
translations.idiomatic: The French judge told the women themselves it had been a mistaken capture across the border.

sentences.zh: 再查界圖，西北有板邦隘，系廣西地。

translations.literal: Again checking border map, northwest has Banbang Pass, is Guangxi land.
translations.idiomatic: The border map further shows Banbang Pass to the northwest in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 又土人言橫模西南離六十里有板邦，屬越地。

translations.literal: Also natives said Hengmo southwest sixty li away has Banbang, belongs to Vietnamese land.
translations.idiomatic: Natives also said another Banbang sixty li southwest of Hengmo lies in Vietnamese territory.

sentences.zh: 峒中之東並無板邦，只有板奔，離峒中約九里，系內地。

translations.literal: East of Dongzhong has no Banbang, only Banben about nine li from Dongzhong, is interior.
translations.idiomatic: East of Dongzhong there is no Banbang, only Banben about nine li away on interior soil.

sentences.zh: 去年秋，萃軍防營駐此，因疫退駐板興，今板奔並無防勇。

translations.literal: Last year autumn, Cuizhou garrison camp stationed here; due to epidemic withdrew to Banxing; now Banben has no garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: Last autumn a Cuizhou garrison camped there but withdrew to Banxing because of plague; Banben now has no troops.

sentences.zh: 又查寧陽離芒街十餘里，在東興西南，中隔河，必船乃渡，即有勇亦難迎庇，且並無勇。

translations.literal: Again checking Ningyang over ten li from Mangjie, southwest of Dongxing, river between—must use boat to cross; even if troops hard to receive and protect, and moreover no troops.
translations.idiomatic: Ningyang lies more than ten li from Mang Cai, southwest of Dongxing across a river reachable only by boat; even if troops were present they could hardly have sheltered bandits there, and none were.

sentences.zh: 」等語。

translations.literal: Such language.
translations.idiomatic: —and similar points."

sentences.zh: 又馮子材電亦云然。

translations.literal: Also Feng Zicai's telegram said the same.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Zicai's telegram agreed.

sentences.zh: 張之洞以兩說歧異，由於華民以溝水為界，法以先安河北岸為界。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong held the two accounts diverged because Chinese people took ditch water as border, France took north bank of Xian'an River as border.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong held that the dispute arose because Chinese took the ditch as the boundary while France took the north bank of the Xian'an River.

sentences.zh: 溝即河也，原圖均未指明。

translations.literal: Ditch is river; original maps both did not specify.
translations.idiomatic: The ditch was the river, but the original maps specified neither.

sentences.zh: 那沙系去年正月新立之墟，距界甚近，故致彼此爭執。

translations.literal: Nasha was market newly established last year first month, very close to border, hence causing mutual dispute.
translations.idiomatic: Nasha was a market founded only last year in the first month, very near the line, which provoked the quarrel.

sentences.zh: 既悉板邦隘另是一地，實屬廣西。

translations.literal: Once understood Banbang Pass was another place, actually Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Once it was clear that Banbang Pass was a separate place in Guangxi, the French claim collapsed.

sentences.zh: 十六年九月，歸逃人魏名高等十八人。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year ninth month, returned fugitives Wei Minggao and seventeen others.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the sixteenth year of Guangxu (1890), eighteen fugitives including Wei Minggao were returned.

sentences.zh: 十七年八月，法使林椿改擬新咖雷多尼招工合同第十四條。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year eighth month, French minister Lin Chun revised Article 14 of New Caledonia labor-recruitment contract.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the seventeenth year of Guangxu (1891), French minister Lin Chun revised Article 14 of the New Caledonia labor-recruitment contract.

sentences.zh: 緣第十四條中國原擬派員作「理事官」，林使不允，改作為「華工統領」，所得權利僅止赴訴公堂及請狀師理論。

translations.literal: Because in Article 14 China originally proposed dispatching an official as "Consular Agent"; Minister Lin did not agree, changed to "Chinese Labor Superintendent"; rights obtained only extended to suing at public court and requesting lawyer to argue.
translations.idiomatic: China had proposed a "consular agent" under Article 14; Lin Chun refused and substituted "superintendent of Chinese labor," whose powers were limited to bringing suits in court and hiring counsel.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章以所改仍與工頭無異，焉得有權保護？

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang held what was changed still differed little from labor contractors—how could there be authority to protect?
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang objected that the revised title differed little from a labor broker and afforded no real power of protection.

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: Not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He refused.

sentences.zh: 時湖南民攻詆洋教，法領事欲赴長沙開馬頭、設教堂，阻之。

translations.literal: At the time Hunan people attacked and reviled foreign religion; French consul wished to go to Changsha to open a wharf and establish church—obstructed.
translations.idiomatic: As Hunan was attacking foreign missions, the French consul sought to open a wharf and church in Changsha but was blocked.

sentences.zh: 十九年四月，請東興、芒街接修電線。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year fourth month, requested connecting telegraph lines between Dongxing and Mangjie.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the nineteenth year of Guangxu (1893), France asked to link telegraph lines between Dongxing and Mang Cai.

sentences.zh: 粵督以前辦界案，尚有數十里至今未定，遽與接線，界未劃定之處歸何人保護？

translations.literal: Guangdong governor held regarding prior border cases, several tens of li still undetermined to now—hastily connecting lines, in undetermined border who would protect?
translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong governor replied that dozens of li of border from earlier cases remained unsettled; who would protect an undemarcated stretch if lines were joined hastily?

sentences.zh: 必致多生轇轕。

translations.literal: Would necessarily cause many entanglements.
translations.idiomatic: It would only breed further disputes.

sentences.zh: 仍促先速定界。

translations.literal: Still urged first rapidly fixing border.
translations.idiomatic: He urged that the boundary be settled first.

sentences.zh: 二十年，法使日海遞國書。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, French minister Nichigai presented credentials.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year of Guangxu (1894), French minister Nichigai presented his credentials.

sentences.zh: 又議寓越華人減身稅事，並論暹羅邊界。

translations.literal: Also deliberated reducing head tax for Chinese residing in Vietnam, and discussed Siam border.
translations.idiomatic: He also discussed reducing the poll tax on Chinese in Vietnam and raised the Siam frontier.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章據英與法議暹羅交界有甌脫地，應歸中國，日海不允。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang citing England and France deliberating Siam border had buffer land that should return to China—Nichigai did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang cited Anglo-French talks on the Siam frontier and argued that a buffer strip should revert to China; Nichigai refused.

sentences.zh: 三月，與法會勘欽、越界。

translations.literal: Third month, jointly surveyed Qinzhou-Vietnam border with France.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month China and France jointly surveyed the Qinzhou–Vietnam border.

sentences.zh: 初，法派巴拉第、法蘭亭均以約內載明屬我之板興、嶺懷等處爭為己有，政府不允。

translations.literal: Initially France dispatched Palardi and Franchin—both contended places treaty stated belonged to China such as Banxing and Linghuai were their own; government did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: France had first sent Palardi and Franchin, who claimed Banxing, Linghuai, and other places the treaty assigned to China; the government refused.

sentences.zh: 至是法改派柯麻暨其總辦籞釐籥接辦。

translations.literal: At this France reassigned Cogordan and his superintendent Yuxi to take over.
translations.idiomatic: France then reassigned Cogordan and his chief officer Yuxi to continue the work.

sentences.zh: 粵督李瀚章派李受彤與會勘，始知巴拉第、法蘭亭所爭險要，與越南皆隔深溝峻嶺，而溝尤多。

translations.literal: Guangdong governor Li Hanzhang dispatched Li Shoutong to joint survey; only then learned Palardi and Franchin's contested strategic places were all separated from Vietnam by deep ditches and steep ridges—and ditches especially many.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong governor Li Hanzhang sent Li Shoutong to join the survey and learned that the strategic points Palardi and Franchin had claimed were separated from Vietnam by deep ravines and steep ridges, with ravines especially numerous.

sentences.zh: 因與約定，按界線有水處以水為界，有山處以山為界，計長四百里。

translations.literal: Thereupon agreed that along boundary line where water, use water as border; where mountains, use mountains as border—total length four hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: They agreed that waterways would form the boundary where water lay and ridges where mountains stood, for a total length of four hundred li.

sentences.zh: 陸界僅五十里，皆峻嶺，餘悉溝界，惟披勞縱橫約三里，各分一半。

translations.literal: Land border only fifty li, all steep ridges; remainder all ditch border; only Pilao spanning about three li, each divided half.
translations.idiomatic: The land boundary ran only fifty li along steep ridges; the rest followed ravines, except Pilao, about three li across, which was divided equally.

sentences.zh: 餘如原勘圖約所載，分茅嶺、板興、板典、嶺懷等處，及峒中十里，均歸中國。

translations.literal: Remainder as original survey map treaty recorded—Fenmaoling, Banxing, Bandian, Linghuai and other places, and Dongzhong ten li—all returned to China.
translations.idiomatic: As in the original survey map and treaty, Fenmaoling, Banxing, Bandian, Linghuai, and ten li around Dongzhong all remained Chinese.

sentences.zh: 時滇、越亦議界。

translations.literal: At the time Yunnan and Vietnam also deliberated border.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan and Vietnam were negotiating their border at the same time.

sentences.zh: 滇督王文韶不允爭已定界，祗就黃樹皮、箐門及猛岡各處向駐有華兵處，緩撤兵以待法防之至。

translations.literal: Yunnan governor Wang Wenshao did not agree to dispute already fixed border; only at Huangshupi, Qingmen, and Menggang and other places where Chinese troops had been stationed, slowly withdrew troops awaiting French garrison arrival.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan governor Wang Wenshao refused to reopen settled lines; he only delayed withdrawing Chinese troops from Huangshupi, Qingmen, and Menggang until French garrisons arrived.

sentences.zh: 界約遂定。

translations.literal: Border treaty thereupon was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: The border agreement was settled.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，中、日約成，法求換商約、界約，遂許開龍州、蒙自等埠，並與越界線內猛烏、烏得二地。

translations.literal: Twenty-first year, China-Japan treaty completed; France sought to exchange commercial treaty and border treaty, thereupon permitted opening Longzhou, Mengzi and other ports, and also within Vietnam border line gave Mengwu and Wude two places.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of Guangxu (1895), after the Sino-Japanese treaty was concluded, France pressed to revise the commercial and border agreements; China then allowed the opening of Longzhou, Mengzi, and other treaty ports and ceded Mengwu and Wude within the Sino-Vietnamese border.

sentences.zh: 初，中國認此二地為寧洱縣屬車裏土司之地，法使謂舊屬越，遂歸法有。

translations.literal: Initially China regarded these two places as Cheli tusi territory subordinate to Ning'er county; French minister said formerly belonged to Vietnam, thereupon returned to French possession.
translations.idiomatic: China had held that these two districts belonged to the Cheli native chieftain under Ning'er county, but the French minister claimed they had long been Vietnamese, and they were awarded to France.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，法要求瓊州不割讓租借於他國，許之。

translations.literal: Twenty-third year, France requested Qiongzhou not be ceded or leased to other states; permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year of Guangxu (1897), France demanded that Qiongzhou not be ceded or leased to any other power, and China agreed.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，法乘廣東雷州人殺其士民二人，以兵艦據廣州灣，來商租借，言為停船屯煤之所，無損中國主權，而所租借跨高、雷二府之間，由海岸以入內地，所得東海、匈洲各島，及赤坎、志滿、新墟等處，均歸入租界。

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year, France seized on Guangdong Leizhou people killing its gentry and commoners two persons, with warships occupied Guangzhou Bay, came to negotiate lease, saying it was place for anchoring ships and storing coal, without impairing Chinese sovereignty; yet leased area spanned between Gaozhou and Leizhou two prefectures, from coast entering interior—obtained Donghai, Naozhou various islands, and Chikan, Zhiman, Xinxu and other places, all incorporated into concession.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu (1898), after two French subjects were killed in Leizhou, Guangdong, French warships seized Guangzhou Bay (Kwangchow Wan) and opened lease talks, claiming the site was only for coaling and anchorage and would not impair Chinese sovereignty; the lease nonetheless straddled Gaozhou and Leizhou prefectures from the coast inland, and Donghai, Naozhou, and the mainland sites Chikan, Zhiman, and Xinxu were all folded into the concession.

sentences.zh: 又得吳川之半島及通明港。

translations.literal: Also obtained Wuchuan peninsula and Tongming harbor.
translations.idiomatic: France also took the Wuchuan peninsula and Tongming Harbor.

sentences.zh: 是年，又以兵強佔上海、寧波四明公所義地，寧人罷巿，幾激變。

translations.literal: That year, also with troops forcibly occupied Shanghai and Ningbo Siming guild charitable land; Ningbo people boycotted market, nearly provoked uprising.
translations.idiomatic: That same year French troops forcibly seized charitable land belonging to the Siming guild halls in Shanghai and Ningbo; Ningbo merchants shut the markets and nearly sparked a riot.

sentences.zh: 久之始定。

translations.literal: After long time only then settled.
translations.idiomatic: Only after a long interval was the matter settled.

sentences.zh: 時廣西永安有殺斃法教民之事，方議辦犯、劾官、賠償、建堂四條，適值北海鐵路造至南寧，援龍州鐵路案，中、法合辦，法使遂要求將鐵路歸併教案。

translations.literal: At the time Guangxi Yong'an had incident of killing French converts; just deliberating four articles—punish culprits, impeach officials, compensation, build church—when Beihai railway construction reached Nanning; citing Longzhou railway precedent, China and France jointly operated; French minister thereupon demanded merging railway into church-case settlement.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile in Yong'an, Guangxi, French converts had been killed, and officials were negotiating the usual four terms—punish the guilty, discipline officials, pay indemnity, and rebuild the church—when the Beihai railway reached Nanning; citing the Longzhou railway precedent for Sino-French joint operation, the French minister insisted the railway dispute be folded into the missionary case.

sentences.zh: 議久始允就案議結，不及他事。

translations.literal: Deliberated long before permitted to settle on the case alone, not extending to other matters.
translations.idiomatic: After prolonged talks China agreed to settle only the case at hand, without conceding anything further.

sentences.zh: 又施南、宜昌、長沙均因教堂、教民啟釁未結。

translations.literal: Also Shinan, Yichang, Changsha all because of churches and converts provoked incidents still unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: Missionary disputes likewise remained open at Shinan, Yichang, and Changsha.

sentences.zh: 二十六年春，拳匪亂，法人調兵與德、英、俄、美、日本聯軍入京，復督兵西進至廣昌，屢阻之。

translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year spring, Boxer bandits rebellion; French dispatched troops with Germany, Britain, Russia, America, Japan allied armies into capital; again directed troops westward advancing to Guangchang, repeatedly blocked.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twenty-sixth year of Guangxu (1900), during the Boxer uprising, France sent troops with the German, British, Russian, American, and Japanese expeditionary forces into Beijing, then marched west as far as Guangchang, where Chinese forces repeatedly blocked them.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，展漢口租界。

translations.literal: Twenty-seventh year, expanded Hankou concession.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year of Guangxu (1901), the Hankou French concession was enlarged.

sentences.zh: 是年法遣鮑渥為駐華公使。

translations.literal: That year France dispatched Boutwell as resident minister to China.
translations.idiomatic: That year France appointed Boutwell minister to China.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，外務部與法隆興公司總辦彌樂石訂雲南礦務章程。

translations.literal: Twenty-eighth year, Foreign Ministry with French Longxing Company general manager Milliet concluded Yunnan mining regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year of Guangxu (1902), the Foreign Ministry and Milliet, chief of the French Longxing Company, signed regulations for Yunnan mining.

sentences.zh: 先是彌樂石到滇，與礦務大臣唐炯議欲設中西礦務公司，唐炯入告，奉旨交雲貴總督魏光燾等與彌樂石議，曆七閱月始竣。

translations.literal: Earlier Milliet arrived in Yunnan, with mining commissioner Tang Jiong deliberated wishing to establish Sino-Western mining company; Tang Jiong memorialized court, received decree to entrust Yunnan-Guizhou governor Wei Guangtao and others to negotiate with Milliet—passed seven months before completion.
