translations.idiomatic: Milliet had earlier reached Yunnan and with mining commissioner Tang Jiong proposed a joint Chinese-Western mining company; Tang memorialized the throne, and the court ordered Yunnan-Guizhou governor Wei Guangtao and others to negotiate with Milliet—a process that took seven months to finish.

sentences.zh: 乃入奏，略謂：一，初議限制中國公司延聘礦師，貸用洋款，後亦不入別國洋股，專用英、法礦師，定議；

translations.literal: Thereupon memorialized court, summarily stating: first, initial deliberation restricted Chinese companies hiring foreign mining engineers and borrowing foreign capital, later also no foreign shares from other states, exclusively employ British and French engineers—settled;
translations.idiomatic: They then memorialized the throne, in summary: first, an early proposal to limit Chinese firms in hiring foreign engineers and borrowing foreign capital was revised so that no other nation's capital would enter and only British and French engineers would be employed—this was agreed;

sentences.zh: 一，運礦自修鐵路，接通滇越幹路，訂明俟幹路成時再議，並禁售票搭載客貨，預存限制；

translations.literal: second, transport ore by self-built railway connecting to Yunnan-Vietnam trunk line, stipulated to renegotiate when trunk completed, and forbade selling tickets to carry passengers and goods—restrictions reserved in advance;
translations.idiomatic: second, ore would move on a company-built line to join the Yunnan-Vietnam trunk railway, with further terms deferred until the trunk was finished and with advance limits forbidding ticketed passenger or freight service;

sentences.zh: 一，公司收買山地，按民間租價，公平租賃，地由滇官指交，價由公司照給，逾限三年不辦，原地歸還業主；

translations.literal: third, company purchased mountain land at folk rental prices, fair lease; land designated and handed over by Yunnan officials, price paid by company; exceeding limit three years without development, original land returned to owners;
translations.idiomatic: third, the company would lease mountain land at fair local rents, with Yunnan officials assigning parcels and the company paying; if work did not begin within three years, the land would revert to the owners;

sentences.zh: 一，完納礦稅，議定按出井出爐礦質，每百抽五，抵納稅課，並派員分礦監收。

translations.literal: fourth, complete payment of mining tax, agreed to take from ore raised from shafts and furnaces five per hundred as tax payment, and dispatch officers to each mine to supervise collection.
translations.idiomatic: fourth, mining tax would be five percent of ore raised from shafts and smelters, with officials assigned to each mine to collect it.

sentences.zh: 適彌樂石由滇入京，向外務部催訂合同，外務部告以礦地未定，未便先議章程，並不准攬辦全省。

translations.literal: Just then Milliet from Yunnan entered capital, urged Foreign Ministry to conclude contract; Foreign Ministry told him mining districts not yet fixed, inconvenient to discuss regulations first, and would not permit monopolizing whole province.
translations.idiomatic: When Milliet came to Beijing from Yunnan and pressed the Foreign Ministry to sign a contract, the ministry replied that mining districts were still unsettled, that regulations could not be fixed first, and that a province-wide monopoly would not be allowed.

sentences.zh: 彌樂石允指澂江、臨安、開化、雲南、楚雄等府及元江州、永北廳凡七處，載入章程第一款內，將原議「嗣後別國公司概不准來滇辦礦」，改為「嗣後別國公司概不准在公司所指之地勘采」，以清界限。

translations.literal: Milliet agreed to designate Chengjiang, Lin'an, Kaihua, Yunnan, Chuxiong prefectures and Yuanjiang subprefecture, Yongbei department—seven places in all—entered in regulations first article; changed original clause 'hereafter other states' companies absolutely not permitted to come to Yunnan to operate mines' to 'hereafter other states' companies absolutely not permitted to survey and mine within places company designates,' to clarify boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: Milliet agreed to limit operations to seven jurisdictions—Chengjiang, Lin'an, Kaihua, Yunnan, and Chuxiong prefectures plus Yuanjiang and Yongbei—and had them written into Article 1; the original ban on any foreign firm mining anywhere in Yunnan was narrowed to a ban on prospecting only within the company's designated districts.

sentences.zh: 彌樂石以原議包辦全省礦利，故原歲給京銅一百五十萬斤，並津貼員弁兵勇護廠銀二萬兩。

translations.literal: Milliet because original deliberation monopolized whole province's mining profits, therefore originally yearly gave capital copper 1,500,000 jin, and subsidy for officers, soldiers guarding works 20,000 taels silver.
translations.idiomatic: Under the original province-wide monopoly Milliet had agreed to deliver 1,500,000 jin of copper to the capital annually and subsidize garrison officers and guards with 20,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 今既改為七處，應請減議定繳京銅一百萬斤。

translations.literal: Now since changed to seven places, should request reduction to agreed payment of capital copper 1,000,000 jin.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the grant covered only seven districts, the annual copper tribute was reduced to 1,000,000 jin.

sentences.zh: 護廠費由公司給發，不拘定數。

translations.literal: Works-guard expenses paid by company, not bound to fixed sum.
translations.idiomatic: Guard costs would be paid by the company without a fixed ceiling.

sentences.zh: 招募土勇，改為稟請地方官招募，遴選武官一員管帶。

translations.literal: Recruiting native braves changed to petitioning local officials to recruit, selecting one military officer to command.
translations.idiomatic: Native guards would be recruited through local officials, with one military officer chosen to command them.

sentences.zh: 遂定議。

translations.literal: Thereupon agreement was settled.
translations.idiomatic: The terms were then settled.

sentences.zh: 惟第一款內載有「公司尋出之金、銀、煤、鐵、五金、白銅、錫及火油、寶石、硃沙礦，允給公司承辦」等語，滇督魏光燾以礦類白金、白銅、錫三項為原章所無，因咨外務部，請照滇中前定原章，照會英、法公使，轉令彌樂石仍將三項刪除。

translations.literal: Only first article contained wording 'gold, silver, coal, iron, assorted metals, white copper, tin and petroleum, gems, cinnabar ores company discovers, permitted to company to undertake' and such; Yunnan governor Wei Guangtao because mineral categories platinum, white copper, tin three items were not in original regulations, therefore consulted Foreign Ministry, requested according to Yunnan's earlier original regulations, notify British and French ministers, instruct Milliet still to delete three items.
translations.idiomatic: Article 1, however, listed platinum, white copper, and tin among ores the company might work—minerals absent from the earlier Yunnan draft—so governor Wei Guangtao asked the Foreign Ministry to follow the original Yunnan terms, notify the British and French ministers, and have Milliet strike out those three categories.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，總理外務部慶親王奕劻與法使呂班訂滇越鐵路條約三十四條：:一，鐵路自河口抵蒙自，或由蒙自附近至雲南省城，日後擬改，須彼此商准；

translations.literal: Twenty-ninth year, Prince Qing Yikuang as superintendent of Foreign Ministry with French minister Jean-Baptiste Beau concluded Yunnan-Vietnam railway treaty thirty-four articles: Article 1, railway from Hekou to Mengzi, or from near Mengzi to Yunnan provincial capital; if later wishing to alter route, must be mutually approved;
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year of Guangxu (1903), Prince Qing Yikuang, superintendent of the Foreign Ministry, and the French minister Jean-Baptiste Beau signed a thirty-four-article treaty on the Yunnan-Vietnam Railway: Article 1—the line would run from Hekou to Mengzi or from near Mengzi to the Yunnan provincial capital, with any later route change subject to mutual consent;

sentences.zh: :二至四，勘路繪圖及交地購地各事；

translations.literal: Articles 2 through 4, survey route, draw maps, and hand over land, purchase land various matters;
translations.idiomatic: Articles 2–4 covered surveying, mapping, land transfer, and purchase;

sentences.zh: :五，各項廠棧同時開工；

translations.literal: Article 5, various workshops and warehouses to start work simultaneously;
translations.idiomatic: Article 5 required workshops and depots to be built concurrently;

sentences.zh: :六，鐵軌寬一邁當；

translations.literal: Article 6, rail gauge width one meter;
translations.idiomatic: Article 6 fixed track gauge at one meter;

sentences.zh: :七，鐵路經過地方，不得損壞城垣公署；

translations.literal: Article 7, where railway passes, must not damage city walls or government offices;
translations.idiomatic: Article 7 forbade damage to city walls or yamens along the right-of-way;

sentences.zh: :八、九，購料及挖取沙石、採伐林木各事；

translations.literal: Articles 8 and 9, purchasing materials and digging sand and stone, felling timber various matters;
translations.idiomatic: Articles 8 and 9 governed procurement of materials, quarrying, and timber cutting;

sentences.zh: :十，運路及暫時興工各地，用竣後即交還；

translations.literal: Article 10, transport routes and places temporarily used for construction, after use completed immediately returned;
translations.idiomatic: Article 10 required haul roads and temporary worksites to be restored after use;

sentences.zh: :十一，幹路造成，商接支路；

translations.literal: Article 11, when trunk line completed, may negotiate branch lines;
translations.idiomatic: Article 11 allowed branch lines to be negotiated once the trunk was finished;

sentences.zh: :十二，各執事凡須專門學者，可用外國人；

translations.literal: Article 12, for all posts requiring specialized learning, foreigners may be employed;
translations.idiomatic: Article 12 permitted foreigners in posts requiring specialized training;

sentences.zh: :十三、四，工匠之招募管理及賞恤傷亡、懲辦犯罪各辦法；

translations.literal: Articles 13 and 14, methods for recruiting and managing artisans, rewarding and compensating wounded and dead, punishing crimes;
translations.idiomatic: Articles 13 and 14 set rules for hiring and supervising workers, compensating casualties, and punishing offenses;

sentences.zh: :十五，巡丁可募土民，不得請派西兵；

translations.literal: Article 15, patrol guards may recruit native people, must not request dispatch of Western troops;
translations.idiomatic: Article 15 allowed native patrolmen but barred foreign troops;

sentences.zh: :十六，洋員請給護照事；

translations.literal: Article 16, foreign staff requesting passports;
translations.idiomatic: Article 16 covered passports for foreign staff;

sentences.zh: :十八，租賃房屋事；

translations.literal: Article 18, leasing houses;
translations.idiomatic: Article 18 governed leasing of houses;

sentences.zh: :十九，不得損及民人產業，有則賠償；

translations.literal: Article 19, must not harm common people's property; if so, compensate;
translations.idiomatic: Article 19 required compensation for damage to private property;

sentences.zh: :二十，火藥炸藥之運制及防險；

translations.literal: Article 20, transport and manufacture of gunpowder and explosives and precautions against danger;
translations.idiomatic: Article 20 regulated transport, manufacture, and safe handling of explosives;

sentences.zh: :二十一、二，運貨納稅、免稅各例；

translations.literal: Articles 21 and 22, rules for freight taxation and tax exemptions;
translations.idiomatic: Articles 21 and 22 set freight duties and exemptions;

sentences.zh: :二十三，收費、減費、免費各例；

translations.literal: Article 23, rules for collecting fees, reducing fees, and free carriage;
translations.idiomatic: Article 23 defined standard, reduced, and free fares;

sentences.zh: :二十四，鐵路不准載運交鹽及西國兵械，如中國有戰事，悉聽調度；

translations.literal: Article 24, railway not permitted to carry government salt or Western states' arms; if China has warfare, all obey dispatch;
translations.idiomatic: Article 24 forbade carrying government salt or foreign munitions, and placed the line wholly under Chinese command in wartime;

sentences.zh: :二十八，設專門學堂；

translations.literal: Article 28, establish specialized school;
translations.idiomatic: Article 28 provided for a technical school;

sentences.zh: :二十九，設電線、電話；

translations.literal: Article 29, establish telegraph wires and telephone;
translations.idiomatic: Article 29 allowed telegraph and telephone lines;

sentences.zh: :三十一，滇省派員襄助公司；

translations.literal: Article 31, Yunnan province to dispatch officers to assist company;
translations.idiomatic: Article 31 required Yunnan to assign officers to assist the company;

sentences.zh: :三十二，定公司補償中國查看費，各員來往照料費；

translations.literal: Article 32, fixed company compensation for Chinese inspection expenses and officers' travel and oversight expenses;
translations.idiomatic: Article 32 set company payment for Chinese inspection and supervisory travel costs;

sentences.zh: :三十四，此路十八年期滿，中國可與法國商議收回。

translations.literal: Article 34, when this railway's eighteen-year term expires, China may negotiate with France to recover it.
translations.idiomatic: Article 34 allowed China, after eighteen years, to negotiate recovery of the line with France.

sentences.zh: 是年，法人因吉林教案索賠償。

translations.literal: That year, French because of Jilin church-case sought compensation.
translations.idiomatic: That year France demanded indemnity over a missionary case in Jilin.

sentences.zh: 三十年秋七月，法使館交還欽天監觀象臺儀器二十八件。

translations.literal: Thirtieth year autumn seventh month, French legation returned twenty-eight instruments of Imperial Astronomical Bureau observatory.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn in the thirtieth year of Guangxu (1904), the French legation returned twenty-eight instruments from the Directorate of Astronomy's observatory.

sentences.zh: 三十一年春，法商欲自上海至紹興行輪，阻之。

translations.literal: Thirty-first year spring, French merchants wished to run steamers from Shanghai to Shaoxing; blocked.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirty-first year of Guangxu (1905), French merchants sought to run steamers from Shanghai to Shaoxing and were refused.

sentences.zh: 是年與各國定值百抽五稅則，法有違言，久之始允。

translations.literal: That year with all states fixed ad valorem five-percent tariff schedule; France had dissenting words, after long time only then assented.
translations.idiomatic: That year China and the powers fixed the ad valorem five-percent tariff; France objected at first but eventually agreed.

sentences.zh: 三十二年春正月二十九日，南昌縣知縣江召棠被殺於天主堂。

translations.literal: Thirty-second year spring first month twenty-ninth day, Nanchang county magistrate Jiang Zhaotang was killed in Catholic church.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-ninth day of the first month in the spring of the thirty-second year of Guangxu (1906), Nanchang county magistrate Jiang Zhaotang was murdered in the Catholic church.

sentences.zh: 先是召棠辦教案頗持正。

translations.literal: Earlier Zhaotang in handling church cases was quite upright.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Zhaotang had earlier handled missionary cases with notable firmness.

sentences.zh: 法教士王安之因上年荏港教案，有二教民鄧貴和、葛洪泰在南昌縣監禁，強請釋放，召棠向索縱囚，其一匿法教堂中，王安之不交，函約召棠會飲，被殺。

translations.literal: French priest Wang Anzhi because previous year Rengang church-case, had two converts Deng Guihe and Ge Hongtai imprisoned in Nanchang county, strongly requested release; Zhaotang repeatedly demanded surrender of prisoners—one hid in French church, Wang Anzhi would not hand over; by letter invited Zhaotang to drink together, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: The French priest Wang Anzhi, over the previous year's Rengang missionary case, had demanded the release of converts Deng Guihe and Ge Hongtai, held in Nanchang jail; Jiang Zhaotang insisted they be surrendered, but one was hidden in the French church and Wang Anzhi refused to produce him; Wang Anzhi then invited Jiang to a meeting by letter and killed him.

sentences.zh: 民情大憤，集眾毀法教堂，傷斃王安之及教習等數名，並波及英教堂，久之始定。

translations.literal: Popular sentiment greatly enraged, crowds gathered and destroyed French church, wounded and killed Wang Anzhi and several teachers and others, and also spread to British church—after long time only then settled.
translations.idiomatic: Public fury erupted; crowds wrecked the French church, killing Wang Anzhi and several church teachers, and violence spread to the British mission before order was slowly restored.

sentences.zh: 法人欲坐召棠自刎，及派兵船來贛責償。

translations.literal: French wished to establish that Zhaotang committed suicide, and dispatched gunboats to Gan to demand compensation.
translations.idiomatic: France tried to claim Jiang Zhaotang had killed himself and sent gunboats to Jiangxi to demand indemnity.

sentences.zh: 命鄂督張之洞查辦，屢執仵傷單及醫憑單與爭，終徇其請，賠以法銀二十餘萬。

translations.literal: Ordered Hubei governor Zhang Zhidong to investigate; repeatedly upheld coroner's wound report and medical certificates to dispute, yet finally yielded to their request, compensated with French silver more than 200,000.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Hubei governor Zhang Zhidong to investigate; he repeatedly cited the coroner's report and medical records disputing suicide, but in the end acceded and paid more than 200,000 French silver dollars.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，法遣領事入滇商辦事。

translations.literal: Thirty-third year, France dispatched consul into Yunnan to discuss business.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year of Guangxu (1907), France sent a consul into Yunnan on commercial business.

sentences.zh: 六月，蒙自法郵局設代收遞人役，詰之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Mengzi French post office set up agents to receive and forward mail and couriers; questioned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the French post office at Mengzi began using agents to collect and forward mail, which China protested.

sentences.zh: 九月，索還法人所占塘沽碼頭。

translations.literal: Ninth month, demanded return of Taku wharf occupied by French.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month China demanded the return of the Taku wharf held by France.
